title: Two-terminal-pair multicut dominant description conjecture
statement:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a graph and let $S$ be a set of terminal pairs with $|S|=2$. The **multicut dominant** $\textsc{MultC}(G,S)$ is the dominant associated with multicut incidence vectors. **Two-pair description conjecture.** It is completely described by

$$
x_e\geq 0\quad\text{for all }e\in E,
$$

and

$$
\sum_{e\in(P)}x_e\geq 1
$$

for each $s$-$t$ path $P$ with $\{s,t\}\in S$. The claim would extend the known complete description for one terminal pair; the source presents the two-pair case as an open conjecture, while more efficient separation methods remain separate open questions.
source_name: Markus Chimani, Martina Juhnke-Kubitzke and Alexander Nover, “On the Dominant of the Multicut Polytope”, arXiv:2112.01095 (2021).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.01095

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2021).
